messages:
Maya R: heads up — we just got two customer reports that they didn't receive urgent incident pages for the DB failover earlier. I can see the alert fired in Sentry but notify-bridge didn't send the external page. Anyone seeing alerts suppressed in the router?
Aj Patel: looking. I can see the alert in alert-router logs but there is a suppression flag set: `suppress_window=true` and reason shows `recent-ack-from-group`. Not sure why that applied to external paging, that should only suppress internal channel.
incident-bot: [automated] Alert 02fd3c: high-db-lag triggered. Routing decision: notify-bridge -> suppressed by policy: dedupe-window (600s).
Sara K: :eyes: that dedupe window shouldn't stop external on-call. We changed that rule last quarter. Did a config drift happen?
Leon: running `notifyctl show-queue --tail 50` to check outbound queue.
Leon: ```
2023-11-27T14:02:03Z INFO enqueue alert=02fd3c target=external-pager
2023-11-27T14:02:03Z WARN suppressing target=external-pager rule=dedupe-window
2023-11-27T14:02:03Z INFO ack-check user=group-ops last_ack=2023-11-27T13:58:10Z
```
Leon: queue ended up with many suppressed items, looks like a routing policy is marking external targets as deduped when any group ack exists.
Aj Patel: I can patch the router to set `allow_external_on_dedupe=true` back, but that'll require a quick rollout. Do we want canary?
Maya R: yes canary to one region then roll. Meanwhile we need to make sure on-call actually got paged. Sara, can you call the on-call phone for the scheduled person?
oncall-scheduler-bot: Current on-call: @Leon (primary), @Sara K (backup), shift start: 2023-11-27 13:45 UTC.
Sara K: calling Leon now.
Leon: I didn't get pager, just Slack mention. I have voicemail from a customer saying they re-tried and got human follow-up — we missed 7 minutes of automated paging.
Aj Patel: rolling a canary that sets `allow_external_on_dedupe=true` for us-east-1 only: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: alert-router-config
data:
  allow_external_on_dedupe: "true"
EOF`
Aj Patel: patch applied in us-east-1 canary. Monitoring outbound calls.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Patch applied to alert-router/us-east-1. Rollout 1/3.
Leon: outbound calls resumed in us-east-1 for new alerts. I just triggered a test alert — got a phone call.
Maya R: thanks. Now we need to backfill notifications for customers affected during the suppression window. Which customers were impacted?
Leon: from logs I see external endpoints for acct-id 324, 881, 902 had suppressed sends between 2023-11-27 13:57-14:04 UTC.
Sara K: I'm opening a customer-impact ticket, will message CSM to notify. Short summary: delayed automated paging (7m), manual follow-up occurred, no data loss, but potential SLA blip.
Maya R: good. Also we need a short-term mitigation to avoid repeats: 1) update router config to never suppress external paging on ack, 2) add metric alert for suppressed-external-count > 0, 3) postmortem to root cause.
Aj Patel: applying global change now (rolling): `kubectl patch configmap alert-router-config -p '{"data":{"allow_external_on_dedupe":"true"}}'`
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Patch rollout started: 3/3 regions.
incident-bot: [automated] Suppression policy change detected by deploy: allow_external_on_dedupe=true. Auto-fallback disabled for 30s during rollout.
Leon: monitoring outbound success rate. No further suppressed external sends after rollout.
Sara K: created ticket INC-2023-324-bridge with impact notes and linked customers. Assigned to Aj for config change, Leon for logs audit, Maya for comms.
Maya R: we should also look at why dedupe-window matched across all targets. My hunch: config templating generated a single dedupe-key for multi-target alerts; will assign to infra to verify.
Aj Patel: noted. I'll include the templating check in the postmortem.
Maya R: quick retrospective notes: detection -> ops noticed customer slack pings, on-call manual escalation worked, root cause config drift/templating error causing external paging to be treated as internal deduped target, mitigation applied via canary then global rollback of suppression, customer outreach + ticket filed.
Sara K: :white_check_mark: I'll schedule postmortem for tomorrow EOD and ping legal/CS for the SLA note.
Maya R: thanks everyone. If anyone spots similar suppressed items in other queues drop them here.
Aj Patel: will follow up with exact PR and audit log link. PR: https://git.internal/r/alert-router/compare/allow-external-on-dedupe
Leon: adding final note — recommend we add an integration test that simulates multi-target alert to ensure external paging not suppressed by internal acks.
Maya R: agreed. Action items logged. Closing thread once CS confirms outreach done. :spiral_calendar:
